meta.name: javascript-pro
meta.description: Writes, debugs, and refactors JavaScript code using modern ES2023+ features, async/await patterns, ESM module systems, and Node.js APIs. Use when building vanilla JavaScript applications, implementing Promise-based async flows, optimising browser or Node.js performance, working with Web Workers or Fetch API, or reviewing .js/.mjs/.cjs files for correctness and best practices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编写、调试和重构现代 JavaScript 代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果主要用 JavaScript 开发应用或 Node.js 服务
copy.tagline_en: Write, debug, and refactor modern JavaScript code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you primarily develop applications or Node.js services in JavaScript

howto.what: Claude会使用ES2023+语法编写、调试和重构JavaScript代码，采用async/await、可选链等现代写法，并运行lint检查和补充Jest测试。
howto.when: 当你要编写/调试/重构JavaScript代码，涉及async/await异步处理、ESM模块系统，或优化浏览器/Node.js性能时，该技能会触发。

say.text: 把这个回调函数改成async/await写法。
say.note: Claude会重构为现代异步代码。

say.text: 检查这个.js文件的代码错误并修复。
给这个功能写Jest测试，覆盖率要85%以上。
say.note: 会生成测试文件并执行。

howto.what_en: Claude will write, debug, and refactor JavaScript using modern ES2023+ syntax, async/await patterns, ESM modules, and Node.js APIs, and will run lint checks and add Jest tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to write, debug, or refactor JavaScript, work with async/await or ESM modules, or optimize browser/Node.js performance.

say_en.note: It will refactor to modern async style.

say_en.text: Check this .js file for errors and fix them.
say_en.note: It will lint and correct issues.
It will generate and run tests.
